That digital book was a second catalyst away from heresy to Christianity, though even long after then my faith was rather torpid: I had (in hindsight rather ironically) feared that local churches would too severely distort the message of the Gospel and its obligations, and so avoided them entirely, restricting myself to independent Bible study. The final catalyst I can identify was some months ago, as I even reported to Voat that I finally decided to take my faith in earnest, and thus to attend weekly services.

I notice through time how I am drawn away by God continually from internal contradictions that I would foolishly set up for myself, in favour of the stable consistency of Christ.
